[[Deldrimor Hornbow (unique)|Deldrimor Hornbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] traded by the [[Artisan of Nature]], a [[collector]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 5
:[[Health regeneration]]: -1
:[[Health]] +30 

==Skin==
This uses the same skin as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Hornbow]].

== Replica ==
It is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Hornbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Vampiric]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
